bestBets.overview: HEZ GOT THE SAFE finds it very hard to win as his record suggests however if he is within striking distance on straightening he goes close. GUARANTOR ran well first-up. He rolls forward and gives a kick. JOYOH has ability and attacks this fresh without a trial. ON CUE next best.

raceTips.comment: Small field to kick off the day. The race shape was against So Si God last start, who was back/wide first up in a race which was dominated by the on pacers. She found the line nicely from where she was but was never a winning threat. Expect her to improve with the run under her belt. Guarantor can mix his form but his fresh run indicated that he could be set for a fruitful prep. Hez Got The Safe has fitness on his side. He tried hard in defeat last start when back to this trip. Joyoh next best.

GUARANTOR is no star but this does look a suitable set up for him. He’ll hold a tactical advantage over the fav in running and the other horse in the market will likely be dictated to along the cutaway. Looks a great chance to bounce out, park on speed and try to pinch this on straightening. HEZ GOT THE SAFE looked like he was going well enough to run past Guarantor if the runs had come for him. JOYOH did win first-up at 1000 last prep.

bestBets.overview: BELIEVE AGAIN makes his debut on the back of some sharp trial efforts. W Pike rides and expecting him to get every chance from his middle draw. YOUANMI produced an eye-catching run at his most recent start where he settled at the rear, found traffic problems and finished strongly late. He just needs some luck from his wide draw to be in the finish. BOUTIQUE BELLE has ability and ran well first-up. Pike off for an apprentice is the query. JUST YES ran well on debut and was immediately tipped out for spell. He attacks this first-up for a new stable with the benefit of a nice trial effort.

raceTips.comment: Just Yes has to contend with an awkward draw so he'll need a fair bit of luck, but I'm happy to be in his corner. He's a promising horse who ran a super race on debut back in April before being tipped out. The recent trial with Pike in the saddle was good to the eye. He was back and three wide, no cover but let down strongly under riding. He will be ready to go fresh. Vampi Queen charged to the line on resumption in a tidy return. She had trialled impressively leading into that run. Believe Again has to be respected for the lethal trainer/jockey combo. He's had two excellent trials in readiness for this. Energetic, Wrexham best of the rest.

BELIEVE AGAIN is another Grant & Alana Williams debutante stepping out in this August/September period which is typical of their Champion Fillies / WA Guineas types – who could be on a hit and run mission to get a win on the board, get some experience in the bank and then head off for a spell. Cassandra, Secret Planet, Juniper…Believe Again? JUST YES has only had one run in his life and it was at 1400m at Belmont back in April when finishing off into fourth behind Spellborn, Arizona Sky and Shimmery Star. That looks a form reference with just as much depth to it as this and with the rail out 18m (with a cutaway) and a tired track, it may just prove to be the wider the better? VAMPI QUEEN has always been held in high regard by the market but has had her chance on occasion. BOUTIQUE BELLE looks destined to do it tough.

bestBets.overview: NEWHAVEN  PRINCE was big run in defeat two starts back when he made good late ground behind a talented type. Then last time out he was disappointing after parking on the speed and fading late. From a wide draw no surprise to see him ridden a bit quieter in the run and be finding the line strongly again. OSCAR NO GROUCH attacked the line at Pinjarra. If he is within striking distance on straightening he will play a part. GENERAL NAPOLEON makes his debut on the back of some quiet trials and Pike rides. BUBBLES IN RIO will park on the speed and give a kick.

raceTips.comment: NEWHAVEN PRINCE ran really well first-up behind subsequent winner The Rocket and then second-up loomed the winner at 1400m before hitting a big brick wall at the 100m marker. Comes back to 1200m, can be ridden forward or rearward to suit the track pattern and in a capacity line up of maidens you’re likely to get nearly eachway the field in an extremely open and even contest. BUBBLES IN RIO has gone better since they’ve started riding her for cover and with the third placed horse from that form reference race in stablemate Hot Chix Lane winning last week the form has been franked. Just a bit of a query on her at 1200 and being a 19 start maiden. ALL THE STARS ran really well on debut from the breeze in a fast run race and then did everything possible wrong at start number two. OSCARS NO GROUCH has become a bit of a tease already.

Open race so hoping we can land one at a bit of value. Vaulting Spirit is one of a handful of horses over the odds. The unraced filly pinged out of the gates to lead a recent trial at this track. She nearly won the heat but was nabbed right on the line. From barrier two, she'll be able to park on the speed and with just 53.5kg, she'll gave a huge sight. Oscars No Grouch has race experience and fitness on his side. Loved the way he attacked the line last start. He's had the three starts at this track for three minor placings. Deserted Artie wasn't asked to do much in her trials but the blinkers going on shows intent on debut. Faradio will improve over further but the 1000m trial win last month was impressive to the eye.

bestBets.overview: GET OUT MICK has been racing well all preparation and without a great deal of luck in recent time. He attacks this off another luckless run last Saturday. If he can handle the four day back-up I expect him to go close. CHAMPAGNE CRUSADER should be peaking at his fourth run back from a spell. he found the line well last start behind a talented type. CLEANMEUP is rock hard fit and racing well. He should get a soft run from an inside draw and find the line strongly. LUCKY I AM rolls forward and gives a kick.

raceTips.comment: GET OUT MICK is bursting to win a race. Stiff not to win five back behind Kelvinator, massive in defeat three back behind Yes I Know and God’s Gate three back, split Cinque Stelle and Refemme No Angel two back and then on the weekend finished a luckless sixth behind Main Act in a Westspeed Platinum. On the quick back-up from Saturday to Wednesday and is going as well as anything in this line-up. CHAMPAGNE CRUSADER will probably never quite reach the same level that saw him a flashing light run behind Twisted Steel in a Magic Millions but he can pinch a 0MWLY/Westspeed/Grad 1200 this prep. CLEANEMUP has been caught in this grade for a while now. She’s running consistent honest races and maps a treat but does tend to find one better on the day. LUCKY I AM finally ran a half decent race last start after being plunged unsuccessfully first-up and second-up. Starting to turn a corner.

On pacer Lucky I Am tried hard in defeat here last start. Over this distance, she crossed from the wide draw and put up a few lengths on the rest of the field but was no match for the first two horses over the final 100m. She's now rock hard fit fourth up and she's the only speed horse in the race so Chanel Cooper will be able to dictate to her liking.  Champagne Crusader flew late to run by Lucky Am last start. Thinking that's the right form reference to follow in this race. Under Influence has been sound of late and drops in class for this. He boasts a strong record at this track. Cleanerup maps for a soft run and is a minor winning hope.

bestBets.overview: GRANDAD'S ADICTION continues to run well without being able to crack it for a win. From a good draw he should get every chance and be in the finish again. GINGER AND TONIC ran well last start and has claims if she can repeat that effort. POINT GIBRALTOR was a big maiden winner two starts and then sound last start. AH KUM rolls forward and gives a sight.

raceTips.comment: Grandad's Adiction doesn't win out of turn but it's hard to knock his form at the moment. He enjoyed a soft run when 3rd over this track/trip last start. He hasn't run poorly in his past several starts and looks close to another victory. Gaspardo is going to relish the step up in trip. He was just 1L from the winner in a bunched finish at Pinjarra. Fitter third up and he drops down to 54.5kg for this. Astonisher didn't do much last start but she's a better horse than that. I'm giving her a chance to hit back with the blinkers applied for the first time. Ah Kum will settle handy from the good draw.

GINGER AND TONIC doesn’t win out of turn (1 from 34) but she’s always around the mark and this race does contain a lot of horses who aren’t overly fond of having their photo taken by the team at Western Racepix. Last start in a C3 she finished third to Zeezea and Cosmic Spirit – that’s stronger form than most bring to the table and you’ll get eachway which is exactly what you need to entertain a mare with her strikerate. GRANDADS ADDICTION continues to knock on the door but just like Ginger and Tonic he’s 1 from 25. Hard to get too enthused when he’ll jump favourite and likely under $4. POINT GIBRALTAR bolted in his maiden and then held his own in a C1 under the 60kg. GOLD BEAU is kept fresh and wasn’t too bad second-up.

bestBets.overview: SISTER MARY is in career best form. If she produces her best and with an uninterrupted run she goes close. AWESOME FORCE ran well in his first attempt at a staying trip. He improves off that and gives this a shake.  HERE FOR CHEQUES steps up sharply in trip but if he can get a soft run on the speed expecting to give a big kick and prove the one to rundown. DELICATE WARRIOR rolls forward and has claims.

raceTips.comment: Eternal Romance is a horse I have plenty of time for. Her win two back over the mile was arrogant before she stepped sharply up in trip last start and ran ok. She'll take a stack of benefit from that and the slight rise in trip should only help. This is a weaker race too. Hard to beat. Sister Mary is an honest mare who let down strongly to run into third here last start. That was the same race as Eternal Romance so this is a step back in class. Argyle Star has runs on the board at 2200m. She is rising from the mile where she ran well at Kalgoorlie but she's an out and out stayer.

DELICATE WARRIOR broke his maiden at 2200 and then went into a 54+ 2100 last start – a race that the majority of the market elects come through – and thought he may have just gone a little too slow for his own good, and allowed horses to be right on top of him on straightening with momentum down the centre. Thought he actually did quite a good job to keep fighting on in the finish and will go around double figures in a race that in all honesty is more or less a raffle! ARGYLE STAR won a Dongara Cup when last in work but also won three in a row between 1760 and 2200 on the grass at Northam and Kalgoorlie. Looks nearly ready. SISTER MARY continues to show up deep into a campaign and drops back in grade out of a 60+ Graduation. HERE FOR CHEQUES seems to have forgotten how to win.

bestBets.overview: PURE OBSESSION looks close to breaking through. He ran finished runner-up last start in what looked a strong race. The third placegetter won Saturday. ABOUT TURN shook his maiden with a dominant all the way last start maiden win. He can fire to the front again and is the one to rundown. CENTRE BOND was sound first-up. He improves of that run and has claims. BOUSSAC should be ready to fire at his third run back from a spell and the blinker go on.

raceTips.comment: Choux Shoe was a huge run in defeat here last start. She had a run close to the fence and on a deteriorating track, her rider stuck closer to the rail in the straight. Out wider was the place to be but she still made ground in the run home. She's an honest mare who is super fit and strikes a weaker race here. Pure Obsession let down strongly to beat all bar the winner over this route. He's improved with each run this prep. Radiant Light has the speed to be the lamplighter but there's a bit of pace in this so from a good draw, I expect him to settle a pair back from the leader. Nakita Riordan is a promising apprentice hoop in good touch at the moment.

CLASSIC RULER sat wide throughout last start in a very similar race to this and with Olaf The Snowman coming out and winning on Saturday (albeit in one of the weakest races of all time) it looks decent enough form to be winning this, especially with Pike sticking. Expect they’ll be making ground by this stage of the day and that suits a sit – sprint type like her. CENTRE BOND isn’t easy to catch, however, he’s got the ability to be winning better races than this. Just needs the right cart into it from a tricky alley. Ran better than his trial which is encouraging. ABOUT TURN can lead and expect that’ll be the best way to navigate barrier 1 on Wednesday and avoid the cutaway zone. PURE OBSESSION is building into his campaign now after a slow start.
